subject.title: [Feature]: You are spaming ChatGPT like crazy

question: Should command cron be the supported no-model solution for scripted watcher alerts, or should main-session `systemEvent` reminders also gain an explicit deterministic-delivery mode?
rationale: Current main deliberately separates deterministic command execution from model-owned reminder semantics, so extending bypass behavior requires a product choice about which cron events need reasoning and policy enforcement.

options.title: Standardize on command cron
options.body: Document command payloads with direct delivery as the supported path for email, Slack, and similar watcher scripts that already generate final text.

options.title: Add deterministic reminders
options.body: Introduce an explicit payload or option for direct reminder delivery while preserving model-backed `systemEvent` behavior as the default.

options.title: Add conservative detection
options.body: Automatically bypass the model only for a narrowly defined simple-reminder shape, accepting additional classification and compatibility complexity.

recommendation.title: Standardize on command cron
recommendation.body: Document command payloads with direct delivery as the supported path for email, Slack, and similar watcher scripts that already generate final text.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined history on the heartbeat prompt contract and has already reviewed this issue's product boundary.
